meta.note: Curated Pakistan job-market scope estimates for GrowSmart (relative posting share proxies across LinkedIn Pakistan, Rozee.pk, Mustakbil, and other PK portals). Not live scraped counts — updated from public market signals (P@SHA, Rozee, Qureos-style demand reports).

portals.label: Other PK portals (Bayt, Indeed, company sites)

it_software.label: IT / Software / Digital
it_software.demand_note: Strongest hiring cluster in Pakistan — software, data, cloud, AI-related roles lead LinkedIn and Rozee tech postings.

engineering.label: Engineering / Technical
engineering.demand_note: Steady demand in civil, electrical, mechanical and industrial projects plus telecom/ops roles.

healthcare.label: Healthcare / Medical
healthcare.demand_note: Hospitals and allied health keep hiring doctors, nurses, therapists and support clinical roles.

finance.label: Finance / Banking / Accounting
finance.demand_note: Banks, fintech, audit and accounting firms post regularly for finance graduates and ACCA/CA tracks.

business.label: Business / Management / Sales
business.demand_note: Sales, marketing, operations and management roles stay broad across corporate and SME markets.

education.label: Education / Teaching
education.demand_note: Schools, academies and coaching centres hire year-round; university roles are more competitive.

media_creative.label: Media / Design / Creative
media_creative.demand_note: Graphic design, content, broadcasting and creative production are active, often freelance + agency mix.

science_research.label: Science / Research
science_research.demand_note: Narrower local market — labs, academia, NGOs and specialized industry roles; often fewer openings than IT.

law_gov.label: Law / Government / Security
law_gov.demand_note: Legal, compliance, policing and government tracks exist but hiring is process-heavy and competitive.

trades_ops.label: Trades / Operations / Support
trades_ops.demand_note: Technicians, logistics, reception and ops support roles appear frequently on Rozee and local portals.

arts_culture.label: Arts / Culture / Writing
arts_culture.demand_note: More portfolio and freelance driven; fewer stable full-time postings than corporate tracks.
